Subscription.Description: PowerShell script block logging. Requires the Turn on PowerShell Script Block Logging policy. Targets: Windows 10+, or PowerShell 5.0+
Subscription.Query: <QueryList> <Query Id="0" Path="Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational"> <!-- Script block logged (4104). Level is Verbose for normal blocks and Warning for automatically logged suspicious blocks, so no level filter. --> <Select Path="Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational">*[System[Provider[@Name='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell'] and EventID=4104]]</Select> </Query> </QueryList>
